Part I — Knowledge Base (English)
Bhaiya's Teachings — Knowledge Base (Session 33, English)
Science of Mantra: Dimensions, Parallel Universes, and the Physics Behind Mantra Shakti

Sour ce: a live Ashaeiynn "Mool T atva" Sunday class (~1 hour 41 minutes), following the completion of a Thir d Eye batch, featuring live logistics discussion and an extended, technical deep-dive teaching connecting mantra practice to a dimension/parallel-universe framework.
1. Opening Logistics: Batches, Feedback, and Community Scale

1. Bhaiya opened by announcing that a Third Eye batch had just been completed , with a new batch starting next. 2. A member suggested creating a structured feedback form so members could submit questions in advance rather than each person asking individually in a crowded live session (with 150-200+ people typically joining). 3. Bhaiya's nuanced r esponse: he agreed a form has value and said one existed in an earlier app version and will be reinstated, but cautioned that anonymous forms tend to attract two differ ent kinds of use — genuine seekers who are shy about asking in public, and people using anonymity specifically to make trouble ("ungli karna") since they know that speaking up directly and by name would risk exposing their own personal history (which Bhaiya says he can and does reveal live when needed). 4. His stated preference: encourage members to call or message dir ectly with genuine queries, since all communication is recorded (every audio, script, and data point going back over a year) — this record-keeping is framed not as a matter of "rationing" the guru's shakti, but of manageable, accountable pr ocess . 5. Community scale context: while a given live session may host around 250 attendees, the total r egister ed Ashaeiynn community exceeds 1,200 members.
2. What This "Mool Tatva" Session and Ashaeiynn Are About

1. Ashaeiynn is described as dedicated entirely to work connected with the third eye (drishti) and to strengthening a practitioner's sukshma jagat (subtle world/body) — not about adopting external objects or instructions (crystals, salt water , or similar practices), but entirely about awakening guru shakti . 2. Practitioners are described as sitting among Nath Sampradaya Ram bhakts , whose guru is Shri Hanuman Ji Maharaj , guided by Mata Sita . The specific guru mantra chanted is "Jai Siya Ram" — its rishi is Mata Sita, its beej is "Raam," its keelak is "Roop," and it falls within the Gayatri chhand. 3. Chanting this mantra within proper guru parampara (lineage) allows Hanuman Ji Maharaj to occupy the practitioner's guru-position himself , producing divine experiences, awakening past-life shaktis, and becoming the ultimate source of drishti, shakti, and chamatkar (miracles) — all reached through the process of clearing negativity and pitru influence first. 4. A key clarification about what counts as a r eal "chamatkar" (miracle): telling others about their lives is not the miracle. The real miracle is surrendering your own tattva to God befor e anything else — of fering everything of yourself to Hanuman Ji Maharaj and accepting him fully as guru (tan-man-dhan) befor e any personal ability develops. Only once that full surrender happens is there no longer any "if and but" left. 5. Bhaiya explicitly denies literally "talking" to Hanuman Ji Maharaj on demand — instead, through the grace of saints, one comes to understand the deity's signals/gestur es ("ishara") , since Hanuman Ji Maharaj is described as residing at this guru-
seat in an "ardh pratyaksha" (semi-manifest), awakened form .
3. Foundational Recap: Chakras as Dimensional "Steps," Not Literal Openings

1. Bhaiya recaps (as previously taught) that kundalini shakti, when awakened, visually r esembles a serpent/infinity-symbol shape — and that chakras function like steps or floors ("Dimension 1, Dimension 2, Dimension 3...") that a practitioner ascends through, rather than being separate literal openings.
4. Why "Dimension" Isn't Really About Going "Up"

1. Bhaiya complicates the simple "going up a staircase" picture: Earth itself is simultaneously r otating and orbiting (translating) thr ough space — meaning a fixed "up" direction doesn't meaningfully exist at a cosmic scale; motion is always some combination of rotation and forward translation, producing a spiral/helical path (visually resembling the same "infinity" shape used for kundalini shakti) rather than a straight vertical line. 2. The universe itself is in motion too — this compounding motion (rotation + orbit + galactic/universal movement) means dimension-crossing isn't a straight "elevation," and ultimately loops back toward a similar reference point rather than heading toward one fixed, ever -higher direction. 3. The "same plane" principle: someone who has done intense practice for 20 years and someone who has practiced for only 2 years can, if they happen to be at the same relative "plane" position (not the same total dimension), report the same subjective feeling/experience — even though their underlying dimension/experience level is genuinely dif ferent. This explains why practice duration alone doesn't reliably predict subjective spiritual experience.
5. How Saints Originally "Invented" Mantras

1. According to this teaching, ancient saints observed which loka (r ealm) the incoming prana energy (life for ce) falling upon Earth actually originates fr om, then traveled there via astral travel and extracted a "beej" (seed) — a specific sound/dhwani heard in that r ealm. 2. They combined this beej with the prana energy landing on Earth , and this combination is what actually produces a mantra — described as: beej + prana ener gy = mantra, a "prana tattva" capable of doing things the physical body alone cannot do. 3. Saints then progressively connected their mantras to additional lokas , one after another , building the mantra's reach across multiple realms — described using an analogy of "law of inertia": once a mantra's ener gy is sent into a given loka, it naturally cycles back to the practitioner rather than needing to be manually retrieved, precisely because it is already "in motion."
6. The Mantra Dimension Framework (T ime-Based, Dimensions 1-6)

1. 1st Dimension: the mantra can only move forward or backward. All "tamasik" (dark/lower) mantras, including modern ones commonly seen today , operate only at this first-plane level — they either move forward toward their tar get or "backfire" onto the person who sent them; there is no third option. 2. 2nd Dimension: the mantra can move forward/backward and up/down. 3. 3rd Dimension ("jagrit"/awakened mantra): the mantra becomes capable of full spatial movement. A mantra is considered "jagrit" specifically once it starts producing tangible physical effects for the person it's dir ected toward — e.g., Bhaiya chanting in one location producing an immediately felt ef fect for someone elsewhere. 4. 4th Dimension (T ime): the mantra can move events forward and backward in time — bringing a future event closer , or bringing a past event back — meaning the practitioner can, through the mantra, af fect the sequencing of events in their own life. 5. 5th Dimension: builds on time-forward/backward by adding "up/down" — since literal up/down doesn't exist within time itself, this is explained as access to parallel universes existing at each point along the timeline (recognizing that one is never alone moving through time — many parallel versions move alongside). 6. 6th Dimension: adding a further direction of access produces omnipr esence — the practitioner (or deity) becomes present "everywhere" simultaneously in their awakened state. Hanuman Ji Maharaj is described as having cr ossed this dimension ,
which is why he is described as manifestly present everywhere at once in his jagrit form.
7. The Mantra Dimension Framework Continued (Space-Based, Dimensions 7-10)

1. Dimensions 7 through 10 restart the same forward/backward-up/down-sideways progression, but applied to space rather than time: 7th Dimension is space's first dimension; as a practitioner's tattva expands in four directions simultaneously , it forms a spherical, quantum-like tattva. 2. 8th Dimension (space's second dimension): associated with Brahma Ji . 3. 9th Dimension: associated with Vishnu Ji . 4. 10th Dimension: associated with Shiva — specifically because Shiva's tattva is described as working simultaneously in roughly ten differ ent places at once , which is the basis for describing him as being "in the 10th dimension." 5. Critical disclaimer: this deity-associated "10th dimension" is explicitly not the same scale or type of "dimension" used in the earlier , basic chakra-based teaching — Bhaiya warns members never to directly compare a deity's dimension count to a practitioner's chakra-based dimension count, since the plane and scale involved are completely dif ferent.
8. Deities and Humans Shar e the Same Plane — Only Dimension Differs

1. Bhaiya of fers a crucial clarification: Shiva, Vishnu, Brahma Ji, and Hanuman Ji Maharaj (in his awakened state) all exist on the very same "plane" that ordinary human practitioners exist on — what dif fers between a deity and an ordinary person is only their dimension (their degree of simultaneous, omnipresent reach), not any literal physical elevation or separate plane. 2. Practical implication: to perceive these deities, a practitioner does not need to go "upward" — they need to expand dimension sideways/outward (parallel expansion) , since divine presence ("sarvatra samana" — equally present everywhere) already exists throughout this same infinite plane; the task is shifting one's own "chaan" (stage/plane), not physically ascending.
9. The Four "Charan" (Stages) of Jap

1. Stage 1 jap: ordinary , single-direction mantra repetition. 2. Stage 2 jap: the mantra moves in two directions simultaneously (matching the earlier forward/backward-plus-up/down pattern). 3. Stage 3 jap: involves two mantras working together — one following the stage-2 pattern, and a second moving dif ferently alongside it. 4. Stage 4 jap: the tattva of four mantras is raised together , radiating outward in all four directions into space, forming a spherical, quantum-like tattva. 5. A key marker distinguishing these stages: at stage 2 and stage 3 jap, a practitioner loses track of time (still operating within the "time" dimensional framework, i.e., dimensions 2-3); at stage 4 jap, a practitioner instead loses track of space (transitioning into the "space" dimensional framework, i.e., dimension 7 onward).
10. Beyond Mantra: Kundalini Shakti and Atma Tattva

1. Eventually , active reliance on the mantra itself gives way to kundalini shakti , and later , kundalini shakti gives way to atma tattva (soul element) itself taking the lead. 2. The "spaceship" analogy: first, a "piece" — the mantra — breaks of f and travels ahead, covering a certain distance; kundalini shakti follows and covers further distance; and finally , the atma tattva itself moves forward under its own velocity . 3. This atma tattva, viewed fr om a distance (e.g., at night), is what appears as a star — and wherever such atma tattva elements conver ge, "life" itself is said to form. This is of fered as this teaching's own explanation for why the universe is continuously expanding.
1 1. Distance, Speed, and Time: Why Repetition (Jap Count) Matters

1. Applying the basic relationship distance = speed × time : since the time available to a practitioner doesn't arbitrarily change, covering mor e spiritual "distance" r equires increasing speed — and speed is increased specifically through repetition (jap count). 2. The mor e a mantra is r epeated, the mor e it "generates" and effectively gains speed — this is of fered as the actual mechanism behind why repetition, not the mantra's content alone, determines reach. 3. Example given: the "Jai Siya Ram" mantra is very old and foundational , and is said to require a minimum of roughly one cror e (10 million) r epetitions to become fully "jagrit" (awakened) at its true operating speed.
12. Parallel Universes and Life-or -Death Cases

1. Illustrative example: two people both diagnosed with stage-four cancer — their individual dimension/chakra progress alone cannot resolve this, since the physical prognosis is shared by both. 2. What can help, per this teaching, is examining each person's parallel universes to identify a version of that same person where an equivalent event doesn't lead to death at this point, and then using mantra-driven access to "pull"/connect that alternate outcome into the person's actual life. 3. This mechanism is offer ed as the r eal explanation behind what is colloquially called "God's blessing" in cases of unexpected survival or recovery — not a random act of grace, but a mantra-enabled connection to a genuinely existing paralleluniverse outcome. 4. A person's r each into parallel universes is pr oportional to their mantra's own developed intensity — and parallel universes themselves are described as infinite in number .
13. A Structural Warning: Stay Within Your Own Parallel Universe

1. A practitioner may freely draw upon or adjust things within their own parallel universes without consequence. 2. However , attempting to enter or draw fr om someone else's parallel universe cr osses a r eal boundary and invites correction/punishment from devtas — described using a police analogy: enfor cement only happens once it is noticed ("when police aren't there, no rule applies; when police are there, the rule applies") — but once a saint or deity does notice, the consequence is described as severe ("complaint, then destruction").
14. Devotion (Bhakti) as the Actual Priority Over Pure Technique

1. Bhaiya reframes the entire technical discussion: pure dimensional/technical advancement is not the actual goal. Without accompanying devotion, a practitioner can remain stuck endlessly repeating the same "plane" pattern across lifetimes — referencing the teaching (attributed to a disciple of Maharishi Vyas) that "history always r epeats itself" precisely because, without bhakti, one keeps returning to the same plane again and again. 2. This is why continuous energy/practice matters — first through mantra, later through kundalini shakti, and eventually through atma tattva — each a sequential "step," with the practitioner expected to advance through them, not remain stuck at the first stage. 3. Bhaiya's own stated pr eference is to r emain devoted at the "first stage" himself — not due to any restriction placed on him, but because he has no personal desire to seek advanced siddhis (like sanjeevani vidya or full past-present-future sight) that he could technically request; this is framed as his own personal test/preference (apne aap ka test), not favoritism or discrimination toward members who do progress further . 4. A member's related concern: the worry that developing divya drishti (divine sight) might eventually produce ego ("I am great, I am important") rather than pure devotion. Bhaiya's guidance: focus on bhakti itself — cultivated through satsang (association with saints), consistent prayer , and specifically requesting devotion (not merely power) during hawan/puja practice. 5. Purnima Mahahavan is highlighted as an especially valuable opportunity specifically for gaining "bhakti dimension" — described as potentially raising a practitioner's dimension by 50 to 500 points purely through visiting saints' blessings, with no separate technical ef fort required.

6. The ultimate practical payoff of devotion, per this teaching, is literally mor e usable time : the higher a practitioner's bhaktidriven dimension rises, the longer it takes for them to "fall" back down — meaning "bhakti bina samay milta nahi" (without devotion, time is not granted); devotion is described as the single most valuable resource a practitioner can cultivate, more so than technical mantra knowledge alone.
QUICK RULES SUMMARY

Anonymous feedback forms have real value for shy , genuine seekers, but also attract misuse by people avoiding accountability — Ashaeiynn keeps full records of all communication and encourages direct calls/messages for genuine queries. Ashaeiynn's guru mantra is "Jai Siya Ram" (rishi: Mata Sita; beej: Raam; keelak: Roop; Gayatri chhand) — its purpose is to let Hanuman Ji Maharaj occupy the practitioner's guru-position directly . The real "miracle" in this teaching is surrendering your own tattva to God before anything else — not the ability to tell others about their lives. Chakras function as dimensional "steps," not literal separate openings; kundalini shakti visually resembles a serpent/infinity shape, mirroring the spiral/helical motion of Earth and the universe itself — dimension-crossing is not a simple straight "elevation." Saints created mantras by combining a "beej" (sound extracted via astral travel to a specific loka) with incoming prana ener gy landing on Earth — then progressively connected mantras to further lokas. The mantra dimension framework (time-based): 1D = forward/backward only (all tamasik/dark mantras operate here); 2D = adds up/down; 3D = full spatial movement ("jagrit"/awakened mantra, producing tangible physical ef fects); 4D = time (moving events forward/backward); 5D = adds parallel-universe access at each point in time; 6D = omnipresence (Hanuman Ji Maharaj's level). The mantra dimension framework (space-based): 7D = space's first dimension (four -directional spherical/quantum tattva); 8D = Brahma Ji; 9D = Vishnu Ji; 10D = Shiva (simultaneous presence in ~10 places) — this deity-scale "dimension" is explicitly NOT comparable to the practitioner's chakra-based dimension count. Shiva, Vishnu, Brahma Ji, and Hanuman Ji Maharaj exist on the exact same plane as ordinary humans — only their dimension (reach/omnipresence) dif fers; perceiving them requires expanding dimension sideways, not going "upward." The four stages (charan) of jap: Stage 1 = single-direction; Stage 2 = two-directional; Stage 3 = two mantras working together; Stage 4 = four mantras' tattva radiating in all directions, forming a spherical tattva — losing track of time marks stages 2-3, losing track of space marks stage 4. Practice eventually shifts from mantra, to kundalini shakti, to atma tattva itself taking the lead — atma tattva, seen from a distance, is what appears as a star; where these conver ge, life forms. Distance = speed × time: since available time doesn't change, spiritual "reach" is increased through repetition (jap count), which increases the mantra's ef fective speed — "Jai Siya Ram" reportedly needs roughly one crore repetitions to become fully "jagrit." Two people with identical severe diagnoses may have dif ferent outcomes because a saint's mantra can access a paralleluniverse version of one of them where the same event doesn't end in death — this is of fered as the real mechanism behind "God's blessing." Drawing on your own parallel universes is safe; entering someone else's parallel universe invites devta-level correction, enforced only once noticed (a police-like analogy). Devotion (bhakti), not pure technical/dimensional advancement, is the actual priority — without it, a person can remain stuck repeating the same plane across lifetimes; devotion itself is described as literally buying more usable time before "falling" back down. Purnima Mahahavan is a particularly valuable opportunity for gaining "bhakti dimension" (50-500 points) purely through visiting saints' blessings. Spelling note: the institute's name is written "Ashaeiynn" — use this spelling consistently .
Part II — Q&A Pairs (English)
Bhaiya's Teachings — Q&A Pairs (Session 33, English)
Science of Mantra: Dimensions, Parallel Universes, and the Physics Behind Mantra Shakti
User-style questions with answers gr ounded in this Ashaeiynn Foundation live "Mool T atva" class session. Gr eeting style: "Jai Siya Ram."

Q1. Could Ashaeiynn set up a form so I can ask my questions without having to speak up live in a cr owded session? A: Bhaiya has agreed this has real value and confirms a similar provision existed in an earlier app version and will be reinstated. That said, he notes anonymous forms tend to attract both genuine, shy seekers and people using anonymity specifically to cause trouble — his general preference is direct calls or messages, since all communication is fully recorded.

Q2. Why doesn't Bhaiya just open unr estricted anonymous question forms for everyone? A: Because anonymity can be misused by people who wouldn't ask the same question under their own name, knowing it might expose their own personal history — Bhaiya notes he can and does reveal such history live when someone speaks up directly . Genuine questions, by contrast, are asked without fear , since the person asking has nothing to hide.
Q3. How large is the Ashaeiynn community , really? A: While a given live session may host around 250 attendees, the total registered Ashaeiynn community exceeds 1,200 members.

Q4. What is Ashaeiynn's guru mantra, and what does it mean? A: The guru mantra is "Jai Siya Ram." Its rishi is Mata Sita, its beej is "Raam," its keelak is "Roop," and it falls within the Gayatri chhand. Chanting it within proper guru parampara allows Hanuman Ji Maharaj to occupy the practitioner's guru-position directly .

Q5. What does Bhaiya consider the real "miracle" in this practice — is it being able to tell people things about their lives? A: No — this teaching states plainly that telling others about their lives is not the actual miracle. The real miracle is surrendering your own tattva to God before anything else, fully accepting Hanuman Ji Maharaj as guru in thought, action, and resource, before any personal ability develops.

Q6. Does Bhaiya literally talk to Hanuman Ji Maharaj? A: No — he describes it instead as coming to understand the deity's signals ("ishara") through the grace of saints, since Hanuman Ji Maharaj is described as present at the guru-seat in an "ardh pratyaksha" (semimanifest), awakened form.

Q7. Are chakras literally separate things that open one at a time? A: As covered in earlier teaching and recapped here, chakras function more like steps or floors representing increasing "dimension" — kundalini shakti, when awakened, visually resembles a serpent/infinity-symbol shape moving through these steps, rather than a set of separate literal openings.

Q8. Is spiritual "dimension" r eally about going upward, like climbing higher? A: Not exactly — this teaching points out that Earth itself is simultaneously rotating and orbiting, and the universe itself is in motion, so a fixed "upward" direction doesn't meaningfully exist at a cosmic scale. Dimension-crossing follows more of a spiral/helical path than a straight vertical climb.

Q9. If I've only practiced for 2 years, why might I feel similar to someone who has practiced 20 years? A: This teaching explains that two practitioners at the same relative "plane" position can report the same subjective feeling, even though their total dimension/experience genuinely dif fers — meaning practice duration alone doesn't reliably predict subjective spiritual experience.

Q10. Where did mantras originally come fr om, according to this teaching? A: Ancient saints identified which loka the prana ener gy (life force) falling on Earth actually comes from, traveled there via astral travel, and extracted a "beej" (a specific sound heard there). Combining this beej with the incoming prana ener gy is what produces a mantra — a "prana tattva" capable of doing what the physical body alone cannot.

Q1 1. What is the very first, most basic "dimension" a mantra can operate in? A: The first dimension, where a mantra can only move forward or backward. This teaching notes that all "tamasik" (dark, including most modern) mantras operate only at this level — they either move toward their tar get or backfire onto the sender , with no other option.

Q12. When does a mantra become "jagrit" (awakened)? A: According to this teaching's framework, at the third dimension, once it starts producing tangible physical ef fects for the person it's directed toward — for example, someone in one location feeling an immediate ef fect from mantra chanted elsewhere.

Q13. Can a mantra actually change the timing of events in my life? A: This teaching describes the fourth dimension specifically as time — where a mantra can bring a future event closer or bring a past event back, ef fectively af fecting the sequencing of events in a practitioner's life.

Q14. What does it mean for Hanuman Ji Maharaj to be "everywher e at once"? A: This teaching attributes that to Hanuman Ji Maharaj having crossed the sixth dimension — a state of full omnipresence, where he is manifestly present everywhere simultaneously in his awakened (jagrit) form.

Q15. Are Brahma Ji, Vishnu Ji, and Shiva at "higher levels" than Hanuman Ji Maharaj or ordinary practitioners? A: This teaching associates the 8th, 9th, and 10th dimensions respectively with Brahma Ji, Vishnu Ji, and Shiva — with Shiva's tattva described as working simultaneously in roughly ten places at once. However , it explicitly cautions that this deity-scale "dimension" numbering is not the same scale as the practitioner's earlier chakra-based dimension count, and the two should never be directly compared.

Q16. Do I need to somehow physically rise "above" deities like Shiva or Hanuman Ji Maharaj to per ceive them? A: No — this teaching states that Shiva, Vishnu, Brahma Ji, and Hanuman Ji Maharaj all exist on the exact same plane as ordinary humans; only their dimension (degree of simultaneous presence) dif fers. Perceiving them requires expanding your own dimension sideways/outward, not physically ascending.

Q17. What ar e the different "stages" (charan) of jap mentioned in this teaching? A: Stage 1 is ordinary , single-direction repetition. Stage 2 has the mantra moving in two directions simultaneously . Stage 3 involves two mantras working together in dif ferent patterns. Stage 4 raises the tattva of four mantras together , radiating outward in all directions to form a spherical, quantum-like tattva.

Q18. How would I know which jap stage I'm actually practicing at? A: This teaching of fers a marker: losing track of time tends to mark stage 2 or stage 3 jap (still within the "time" dimensional framework); losing track of space instead tends to mark stage 4 jap (moving into the "space" dimensional framework).

Q19. Does mantra practice eventually give way to something beyond the mantra itself? A: Yes — this teaching describes a progression from mantra, to kundalini shakti, and eventually to atma tattva (soul element) itself taking the lead, using a "spaceship" analogy where each element travels progressively further before the next takes over .

Q20. What ar e stars, according to this teaching? A: This teaching of fers atma tattva itself — visible from a distance — as its own explanation for what appears as stars, with life described as forming wherever such atma tattva elements conver ge.

Q21. Why does r epeating a mantra many times matter mor e than just knowing the "right" mantra? A: Because, per the relationship distance = speed × time, since available time doesn't change, covering more spiritual "distance" requires increasing speed

— and repetition (jap count) is what increases a mantra's ef fective speed. This teaching notes the "Jai Siya Ram" mantra reportedly needs roughly one crore (10 million) repetitions to become fully "jagrit" at its true speed.

Q22. How can two people with the same serious diagnosis have completely differ ent outcomes? A: This teaching of fers an explanation involving parallel universes: rather than relying on dimension/chakra progress alone (which can't resolve a shared physical prognosis), a saint's developed mantra can identify a parallel-universe version of that same person where an equivalent event doesn't end in death, and connect that alternate outcome into the person's actual life — described as the real mechanism behind what's colloquially called "God's blessing."
Q23. Can I use my own parallel universes to help myself? A: Yes — this teaching states a practitioner may freely draw upon or adjust things within their own parallel universes without consequence.

Q24. What happens if someone tries to draw fr om another person's parallel universe instead of their own? A: This teaching warns this crosses a real boundary and invites correction from devtas — enforced only once it's noticed, similar to how a rule is only enforced once police are present; but once noticed, the consequence is described as severe.

Q25. Is advancing thr ough all these technical dimensions the actual goal of practice? A: No — this teaching reframes the entire discussion: pure technical/dimensional advancement isn't the point. Without devotion (bhakti), a practitioner risks remaining stuck repeating the same "plane" pattern across lifetimes; devotion is what actually matters most.

Q26. I'm worried that if my divine sight (divya drishti) develops, I might develop ego instead of r eal devotion. What should I focus on? A: This teaching's guidance is to focus on bhakti itself — cultivated through satsang (association with saints), consistent prayer , and specifically requesting devotion (not merely power) during hawan/puja practice. Purnima Mahahavan is highlighted as a particularly valuable opportunity for gaining "bhakti dimension" through saints' blessings alone.
Bot Response Guidelines (Session 33 additions)

This session's content is highly technical and metaphorical (dimensions, parallel universes, mantra "speed") — present it clearly as this teaching's own explanatory framework, not as an assertion Claude is independently verifying against physics or cosmology . Keep the explicit disclaimer intact whenever discussing deity-associated "dimensions" (8D/9D/10D for Brahma/V ishnu/Shiva): never let a user conflate this scale with the practitioner's chakra-based dimension count from earlier teachings. When discussing the parallel-universe explanation for survival from serious illness, present it factually as this teaching's own framework and avoid implying it as a substitute for medical treatment or a guarantee of any specific health outcome. When explaining jap repetition counts (e.g., "one crore" for Jai Siya Ram), present them as this teaching's stated figures rather than universal facts. Reinforce, whenever technical mantra/dimension content is discussed, that this teaching itself frames devotion (bhakti) — not technical mastery — as the actual priority . Spelling note: the institute's name is written "Ashaeiynn" — use this spelling consistently .
Part III — Curated Conversational Q&A (Hinglish)
Bhaiya's Teachings — Curated Conversational Supplement (Session 33, Hinglish)
Mool Tatva Class ki Live Baatcheet — Forms, Sawaal-Jawab, aur Ek Personal Reflection

Yeh Part III har session mein nahi hota — sirf tab jab sour ce transcript mein genuine live sangat conversation ho. Is Mool T atva class mein teaching bahut technical thi, lekin beech-beech mein genuine live exchanges bhi hue — ek member ka formsuggestion, ek technical pushback sawaal, aur ek gehra personal r eflection sawaal.
